name: Nonohara Haya
source:
(21 in ~Sorekara again~)
An airheaded freeter who works in the same cafe as [url=/c11657]Isshu[/url]. She refers herself in third person with the name Non. She is best friends of [url=/c11652]Karin[/url] and [url=/c91511]Kanata[/url] and loves keeping secrets.
In Memories Off ~Sorekara Again~, she doesn't wear glasses and works as a maid.

[Taken from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Memories_Off_~And_then~]Wikipedia[/url].]
